app.name: B mark
app.tagline: Markdown, with Persian and RTL done properly

toolbar.saveUnavailable: Saving is only available in the desktop build
toolbar.closeDocTitle: Close the document and go back to the start screen — Ctrl+W

empty.hint: Drop a Markdown file here, or open one from disk.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Reset every setting to its default?

language.label: Interface language
language.help: This changes the interface only. The direction of the document you are reading is always detected from its own content.

contentWidth.label: Maximum content width
contentWidth.help: Long lines are hard to read. 860 pixels is roughly 90 characters.

codeFont.label: Code font
codeFont.help: Vazirmatn is always appended, so Persian inside a code block still shapes correctly.

directionMode.label: Document direction
directionMode.help: Automatic weighs the strong characters of each block after removing code, URLs and file paths.

codeDirection.label: Code follows surrounding text
codeDirection.help: Off by default: code, links and file paths are lexical, not linguistic, so they stay left-to-right.

externalImages.label: Load images from the internet
externalImages.help: Off by default. A remote image reveals to its host that you opened the document.

rawHtml.label: Allow raw HTML in documents
rawHtml.help: Even when on, HTML is sanitised: scripts, iframes and event handlers are always removed.

confirmLinks.label: Confirm before opening external links
confirmLinks.help: Links always open in your browser, never inside B mark.

liveReload.label: Reload automatically when the file changes on disk

math.label: Render math formulas
math.help: KaTeX loads only when a document contains $…$ or $$…$$.

diagrams.label: Render Mermaid diagrams
diagrams.help: Mermaid loads only when a document contains a ```mermaid block.

frontMatter.label: Show YAML front matter as a header

toast.fileTooLarge: That file is too large to open ({size}).
toast.linkBlocked: Link opening is only available in the desktop build.
toast.fileChanged: The file changed on disk — reloading.
toast.fileChangedDirty: The file changed on disk, but you have unsaved edits — not reloading.
toast.revealUnavailable: Opening the containing folder is only available in the desktop build.

dialog.openExternal: Open this link in your browser?
dialog.webviewMissingBody: B mark renders through the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is normally part of Windows. It is not installed on this machine. Install it from Microsoft's official page, then start B mark again. B mark will not download anything on its own.
dialog.discardChanges: Discard your unsaved changes and reload from disk?

find.hint: Persian and Arabic spellings are matched loosely: ی/ي, ک/ك, ZWNJ and Persian digits all match.

export.htmlHint: One self-contained file. Fonts embedded, no internet needed.
export.docxHint: Direction is preserved: Persian paragraphs arrive right-aligned in Word.

stats.detail: {words} words · {chars} characters · {headings} headings · {code} code blocks · {tables} tables · {images} images

tabs.confirmClose: “{name}” has unsaved changes. Close it anyway?
tabs.restored: Reopened {n} documents from your last session
tabs.restoreFailed: {n} documents could not be reopened; they may have moved.

persian.fixTitle: Normalise letters, insert ZWNJ, tidy punctuation — Ctrl+Shift+P
persian.noChanges: Nothing to fix — the text is already clean.
persian.needsEditor: Open the editor (Ctrl+E) first — B mark only rewrites a document you are editing.

settings.title: Persian text fixes
settings.normaliseLetters: Convert Arabic ي ك ة to Persian ی ک ه
settings.fixZwnj: Insert ZWNJ in می‌ prefixes and ‌ها suffixes
settings.help: Code, URLs, file paths, e-mail addresses and formulas are never touched.

copy.richTitle: Paste into Word, Outlook or Telegram with formatting and direction intact
copy.richDone: Copied — paste into Word or e-mail

autosave.label: Save automatically while editing
autosave.help: Writes to the file a few seconds after you stop typing.

contentTheme.label: Document style
contentTheme.help: Affects the document itself, and travels with the HTML, Word and printed output.

spell.label: Persian and English spell checking
spell.help: Underlines possible misspellings in the document with a red wave and counts them in the status bar. Windows often has no Persian dictionary, so the webview cannot do this itself. Building the Persian checker takes about 172 MB and 2 seconds, which roughly triples the app's memory use while it is on — so it is off unless you ask for it. Code, links, paths and formulas are never checked.
spell.loading: Building the dictionaries… the first check takes a moment.
spell.unsupported: This build cannot underline misspellings, only count them.

folder.title: Folder
folder.unavailable: Folder browsing is only available in the desktop build.

update.none: B mark is up to date.
update.unconfigured: Automatic updates are not configured for this build.

about.title: About B mark
about.author: Built by Masoud Borodayeh with help from Arena.
about.free: It cost nothing to make, so it is released free of charge — free to use, copy and change under the MIT licence.
